title: a claim file of another issue reaches main by a pull request the protocol check let through
status: fixed after 0.5.0: the protocol check read only the head's own claim file, so a writer's pull request that was no claim's, adding an issue's claim file, passed it, as did a claim stacked on another claim's branch, carrying that claim's file; once merged, the file read as a claim on the default branch, the route to G1 and G11a that F30's model could not express; since the fix the check judges the change a pull request makes against its base and fails one that adds or changes a claim file other than its own issue's on its own claim branch (DESIGN.md, 13)
world: memory; the git world runs it over real git (build step 6)

steps.note: a's draft carries its own claim file, as Claim says, and passes the check

carol, who may write, opens a ready pull request from notes/1 that is no claim's and adds docs/agents/claims/1.md; since the fix the check fails it, and on 20f2a2b it passed, so G12 is red here under the mutant that undoes the fix
the required check fails carol's pull request, so GitHub refuses the merge; on 20f2a2b it would have merged, putting a claim on #1 naming carol on the default branch
b claims #2 from claude/1's head, not from main, so claude/2 carries a's claim file beside its own
b's draft adds docs/agents/claims/1.md against main: since the fix the check fails it, its own claim file passing as it should; on 20f2a2b it passed
b's pull request still adds a's claim file, so the check fails it and GitHub refuses the merge; on 20f2a2b the merge put a's claim file on main while claude/1 still stood
a's own pull request, its claim file deleted at Finish, passes and merges: deleting a claim file passes
with claude/1 merged, the merge of claude/2 into main no longer adds a's claim file, which main took off, so b's pull request passes and merges
